sign-in page with a pending request.body:
Connect your mailbox

Example <AI> App (name supplied by the app) is asking to use your email hosted by Example Hosting. Sign in with the same address and password you use in your mail app.

When you connect, you will return to app.example.org. Only continue if you started this from your own AI app just now.

Several mailboxes

To connect several mailboxes, such as your staff's, paste the whole list here, one mailbox per line: the address, a space, then that mailbox's password. You can then leave the two fields above empty. Up to 2 more. Every mailbox you want must be in this one sign-in: signing in again replaces the earlier list in your AI app. Every password is checked before anything is connected, which can take a minute for many mailboxes.

Need help? https://help.example.org/ or help@example.org
